name: @flyfish-group/file-viewer-open-source
description: Browser-native, offline-first file preview components, renderers, presets, demos and documentation.

scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:renderers && pnpm build:capabilities && pnpm build:presets && pnpm build:components && pnpm build:tools && pnpm build:thumbnail && pnpm build:examples && pnpm build:demo
scripts.type-check: pnpm type-check:core && pnpm type-check:renderers && pnpm type-check:capabilities && pnpm type-check:presets && pnpm type-check:thumbnail && pnpm type-check:components && pnpm type-check:tools && pnpm --filter @flyfish-group/file-viewer-demo type-check
scripts.test:cad-output-github-245: pnpm exec vitest run test/cad-output.spec.ts test/snapshot-download.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/renderer-cad verify:color-mode
scripts.test:ofd-resources-github-57: pnpm exec vitest run test/ofd-resource-paths.spec.ts test/ofd-image-geometry.spec.ts test/ofd-lifecycle.spec.ts
scripts.test:pptx-assets-github-140: pnpm exec vitest run test/copied-assets.spec.ts test/presentation-renderer.spec.ts test/presentation-lifecycle.spec.ts
scripts.test:word-revisions-github-255: pnpm exec vitest run test/word-revisions.spec.ts test/word-native-revisions.spec.ts test/vue3-render-options.spec.ts
scripts.test: pnpm test:i18n && pnpm test:thumbnail && pnpm test:archive-github-101 && pnpm test:archive-github-148 && pnpm test:cad-output-github-245 && pnpm test:doc-github-171 && pnpm test:doc-github-192 && pnpm test:doc-github-236 && pnpm test:doc-github-34 && pnpm test:doc-github-87 && pnpm test:email-github-232 && pnpm test:html-preview-github-256 && pnpm test:ofd-github-177 && pnpm test:ofd-github-94 && pnpm test:ofd-resources-github-57 && pnpm test:pdf-cjk-font-github-242 && pnpm test:pptx-assets-github-140 && pnpm test:pptx-github-176 && pnpm test:requirejs-github-258 && pnpm test:shadow-focus-github-243 && pnpm test:spreadsheet-github-175 && pnpm test:spreadsheet-github-178 && pnpm test:spreadsheet-github-234 && pnpm test:vite-copy-assets-github-257 && pnpm test:word-revisions-github-255
scripts.type-check:components: pnpm --filter @file-viewer/web type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/react type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/react-legacy type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/vue3 type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/vue2.7 type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/vue2.6 type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/jquery type-check && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/svelte type-check
scripts.verify:renderer-sanitization: pnpm --filter @file-viewer/pptx build && node apps/viewer-demo/scripts/verify-renderer-sanitization.mjs && pnpm verify:docx-external-resource-policy && pnpm verify:rtf-link-policy
scripts.verify:rtf-link-policy: pnpm --filter @file-viewer/doc build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/core build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/renderer-word build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/renderer-word verify:rtf-security
scripts.verify:presentation-entrypoints: pnpm --filter @file-viewer/core build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/pptx build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/renderer-presentation build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/vite-plugin build && node apps/viewer-demo/scripts/verify-presentation-entrypoints.mjs
scripts.verify:chm-renderer: pnpm --filter @file-viewer/core build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/renderer-chm build && pnpm --filter @file-viewer/assets-chm verify
